title: One Tag, Three Announcements
tagline: Release notes, email, thread — one agent
outro: Tag it once. Announce it everywhere.
script: You cut a release... Now comes the boring part: release notes, the announcement email, the thread. Hand it to your agent. A routine checks your repo on schedule — or you just ask when the tag lands... It reads the pull requests behind the release, checks CI passed, and writes the release notes on GitHub — with your approval on the publish... Then the fan-out: an email drafted in your Gmail, a thread delivered to your chat, ready to post... The voice is yours — the format lives in a skill, a Markdown playbook you write once. Tag it once... Announce it everywhere.
